update "runs" set "state" = ?, "completed_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
), "result" = ?, "wake_event" = ?, "event_payload" = ?, "wake_step" = ?, "claimed_by" = ?, "claim_expires_at_ms" = ?, "fence_stamp" = ?, "fence_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) where "run_id" = ? and "queue" = ? and "claimed_by" = ? and "state" = ? and EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
           WHERE t.task_id = runs.task_id AND t.queue = runs.queue
             AND (t.state NOT IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
               OR (t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs sibling
               WHERE sibling.task_id = runs.task_id
                 AND sibling.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
                 AND sibling.run_id <> runs.run_id)))
         )

UPDATE tasks SET state = 'completed',
         completed_payload = ?,
         cancel_at_ms = NULL,
         fence_stamp = ?,
         fence_at_ms = (SELECT MIN(f.fence_at_ms) FROM runs f
                        WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
       WHERE (task_id IN (SELECT f.task_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
         AND (state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')))

DELETE FROM waits
       WHERE (run_id IN (SELECT f.run_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.fence_stamp = ?))
